description: This file is an Android activity class named KeyChainDemoActivity, part of a sample project demonstrating Android's KeyChain API for managing SSL certificates and private keys. It handles installing a PKCS12 keychain, selecting a key alias, displaying certificate information, and starting/stopping a simple SSL server for testing purposes.

classes.name: KeyChainDemoActivity
classes.description: An Android Activity that demonstrates how to install a PKCS12 keychain, select a key alias, and display key/certificate information, with UI controls for managing a simple SSL test server.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes UI components, checks keychain accessibility, sets button handlers, and manages SSL server lifecycle.

methods.name: onNewIntent
methods.description: Handles intents to stop the SSL server when requested.

methods.name: alias
methods.description: Callback invoked with the user-selected key alias; saves alias and updates UI.

methods.name: getAlias
methods.description: Retrieves the stored key alias from SharedPreferences.

methods.name: setAlias
methods.description: Stores the selected key alias in SharedPreferences.

methods.name: printInfo
methods.description: Displays the certificate chain and private key info for the selected alias.

methods.name: installPkcs12
methods.description: Reads PKCS12 file from assets and initiates its installation via an intent.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles result from keychain installation activity.

methods.name: chooseCert
methods.description: Prompts the user to select a private key alias from the keychain.

methods.name: getCertificateChain
methods.description: Fetches the certificate chain for a given alias.

methods.name: getPrivateKey
methods.description: Retrieves the private key for the specified alias.

methods.name: isKeyChainAccessible
methods.description: Checks if the keychain with the current alias is accessible (certificates and keys are available).

methods.name: startServer
methods.description: Starts the background SSL web server service.

methods.name: stopServer
methods.description: Stops the background SSL web server service.

methods.name: disableKeyChainButton
methods.description: Disables the keychain installation button once installation is confirmed.
